content: <thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion appears at m/z ≈ 100.05, which is consistent with a protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.0073 Da) gives a neutral mass of ≈ 99.04 Da. The formula that best matches this neutral mass is C₄H₅O₂N (exact mass = 99.0320 Da). Adding a proton yields an m/z of 100.039 Da, matching the observed peak within experimental tolerance. Therefore the molecular formula of the sample is C₄H₅O₂N.
